findings.title: Live2D expression may be reapplied on every embodiment intent
evidence: app/public/live2d/viewer.html: message handler calls applyEmbodiment for every accepted intent
app/public/live2d/viewer.html: applyEmbodiment calls applyExpression when expression is present
app/src/components/AvatarStage.tsx: mouth pose updates around every 40 ms while speaking
findings.impact: Repeated expression transitions may be reset during lip-sync updates; visual impact is not measured in a real browser.
findings.recommendation: Cache the applied expression and only call model.expression on an actual expression transition; add a regression proving mouth-only updates do not restart it.

findings.title: Browser TTS and Android/Termux runtime voice are separate control paths
evidence: AvatarStage uses window.speechSynthesis and SpeechSynthesisUtterance directly
app/src/neuro-kurisu/api.ts exports voiceSpeak, voiceListen, voiceTurn, voiceStatus and voiceInterrupt
runtime/neuro-kurisu/src/server/server.mjs exposes /api/organism/voice/* routes with approval handling
runtime/neuro-kurisu/src/organism/body/AndroidEmbodimentBridge.ts implements Termux TTS/STT
findings.impact: The browser voice toggle does not represent Android/Termux capability or runtime voice status; a visible microphone/listen path is not present in AvatarStage.
findings.recommendation: Document separate providers explicitly or route UI through one canonical voice controller with shared event identity, status and interruption semantics.

findings.title: Legacy sprite fallback does not guard localStorage errors
evidence: app/src/legacy/avatar/LegacySpriteDeck.tsx reads localStorage in the state initializer without try/catch
app/src/legacy/avatar/LegacySpriteDeck.tsx writes localStorage in an effect without try/catch
AvatarStage.tsx already catches storage failures
findings.impact: A SecurityError from blocked storage may prevent the fallback component from mounting or updating.
findings.recommendation: Use safe read/write helpers and test a throwing localStorage implementation.

findings.title: Legacy speaking indicator is not lip synchronization
evidence: app/src/legacy/avatar/LegacySpriteDeck.tsx draws a pulsing ellipse while speaking
findings.impact: Fallback provides a speaking cue, not articulated mouth poses.
findings.recommendation: Label as degraded visual fallback; do not claim full lip-sync.

findings.title: Viseme timeline is grapheme-timed approximation, not acoustic phoneme synchronization
evidence: app/src/components/avatar/embodimentTimeline.ts documents lack of PCM/phoneme boundaries in Web Speech API
AvatarStage anchors timeline to browser speech boundary/elapsedTime events
viewer applies mouth-open and mouth-form parameters
findings.impact: Mouth timing and articulation can drift from actual audio; no measured RU/EN offset or jitter is recorded.
findings.recommendation: Measure offset/jitter; integrate acoustic/phoneme timing if the chosen provider exposes it.

findings.title: Current branch CI does not validate the UI/Live2D/voice path

WorkPass71 validation includes app tests, typecheck, development build, embodiment timeline and speech gateway/concurrency tests

findings.recommendation: Run or wire app and speech tests to push/pull_request on the active branch; add a separate real-browser E2E job.
